topics.title: Quantile mapping
topics.overview: Quantile mapping corrects a climate model's distribution by mapping its quantiles onto observed ones. These papers run from the method's definition and comparison of transform families, through the objections raised against it — that it cannot add fine-scale skill, and that it distorts the projected trend — to the variants proposed in answer, and to the question of how the calibration sample should be split. Two further papers describe how daily temperature is actually distributed, which is what the parametric variants assume.
